attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording for Analysts'/Investors' Post Earnings Conference Call held on Thursday 19th November 2026 at 3:00 PM IST.
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has disclosed the audio recording of the post-earnings conference call held on 19th November 2026. The call discussed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The audio recording is available via a Google Drive link and on the company website at www.markolines.com. The announcement was signed by Mr. Sanjay Patil, Chairman and Managing Director, with DIN 0029052.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "Press Release   Receipt of Work Orders Aggregating Rs. 234.83 Crore".
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited secured three work orders aggregating Rs. 234.83 crore inclusive of GST. The orders cover infrastructure development and road maintenance projects in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Andhra Pradesh. Two orders from RKEC Projects Limited total Rs. 178.12 crore. These include bridge construction valued at Rs. 120.28 crore and highway rehabilitation worth Rs. 57.84 crore. A third order from Ranastalam Anandapuram Road Limited is valued at Rs. 56.71 crore. The company's unexecuted order book now stands at approximately Rs. 800 crore. The announcement was filed on 18th November 2026.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited filed an investors presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 86.02 Cr for Q2 FY27, up 10.75% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 11.34 Cr with a margin of 13.18%. Profit after tax was Rs. 4.95 Cr, reflecting a 21.21% year-on-year increase. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.23. For the half year, revenue reached Rs. 161.88 Cr and PAT was Rs. 9.31 Cr. The unexecuted order book stood at Rs. 624.22 Cr as of September 30, 2026. The board approved the amalgamation of Markolines Infra Limited into the company on March 6, 2026, with SEBI clearance obtained. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Please find attached the Press Release issued by Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited regarding the receipt of work orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for road resurfacing works using microsurfacing technology on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, aggregating to approximately ₹135.20 Crores.".

Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited ( the Company ) is pleased to inform that it has received two Letters of Acceptance-cum-Work Orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for undertaking microsurfacing works on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, Mumbai, aggregating to ₹135.20 Crores.The detailed disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 is enclosed herewith.
